gdpr/cross-border-transfer-safeguards.applicability_reason: Prompt content leaves the developer's machine on the one outbound call to the Anthropic API, so the transfer basis for that flow must be established and documented.

gdpr/data-minimisation-accuracy-retentio.applicability_reason: The plugin chooses which session-transcript excerpts to send to the API and which derived markdown and JSON to persist under tracked repository paths, so minimisation and retention of that derived content are design decisions it owns.

gdpr/data-subject-transparency-complaint.applicability_reason: There is no end user beyond the engineer who installed it and no third party whose data passes through it, so there is no subject-facing intake or complaints flow to provide.

gdpr/dpia-prior-consultation-workflow.applicability_reason: The plugin performs none of the high-risk triggers — no profiling, no systematic monitoring, no special-category data and no personal data as a product function.

gdpr/dpo-designation-governance.applicability_reason: Designation triggers on core-activity monitoring or large-scale special-category processing, and this is local developer tooling with no hosted service, no tenant and no personal data collection.

gdpr/encryption-security-of-processing.applicability_reason: The plugin reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from the environment at call time and transmits repository content over the network, so transport security and non-persistence of secrets are core controls.

gdpr/instruction-bound-access-control-le.applicability_reason: The plugin's write scope — tracked repository paths only, nothing under .claude/ and nothing outside the repository — is exactly a least-privilege boundary that must be enforced, not merely asserted.

gdpr/lawful-basis-purpose-governance.applicability_reason: The plugin does no processing on behalf of a customer or controller and acts only on the developer's own files on their own machine, so there is no processing activity of the authors to bind to a lawful basis.

gdpr/objection-opt-out-management.applicability_reason: There is no marketing, no profiling and no user-facing surface at all, so there is no processing anyone could object to and no preference state to hold.

gdpr/privacy-by-design-default.applicability_reason: What transcript content the hooks read, what is sent to the API and what is written back into the repository are build-time design choices that must default to the minimum necessary.

gdpr/privacy-notice-transparency-deliver.applicability_reason: The plugin sends the developer's own repository text and session-transcript excerpts to the Anthropic API, and that outbound flow must be disclosed plainly to the engineer installing it.

gdpr/processor-joint-controller-contract.applicability_reason: The authors engage no processor: the single recipient is the Anthropic API called with the developer's own credentials, and the developer chooses the account and holds the contract with Anthropic directly.

gdpr/records-of-processing-authority-coo.applicability_reason: The authors operate no server, receive nothing from users and carry out no processing activity of their own, so there is no controller or processor record to maintain for this product.

gdpr/rectification-erasure-restriction-p.applicability_reason: All outputs are plain markdown and JSON files in the developer's own git-tracked repository, which the developer edits, reverts or deletes directly; the plugin adds no store of its own.

gdpr/requester-identity-verification.applicability_reason: There is no service to log in to, no account and no rights-request pipeline, so there is no requester whose identity could need proofing before disclosure.

gdpr/security-testing-effectiveness-asse.applicability_reason: The plugin reads local session transcripts, handles credentials from the environment and makes an outbound API call, so the effectiveness of those controls needs recurring testing.

gdpr/special-category-children-s-data-pr.applicability_reason: The plugin holds no health, biometric or other special-category data and is used by software engineers in their own checkout, not offered as an online service to children.
